purpose: Maps user-prompt trigger phrases to PRISM capabilities so the UserPromptSubmit hook (capability-reminder.mjs) can surface the right tool at the moment of need. Complements ai-auto-command-router.mjs (which suggests slash commands) by covering scripts, hooks, engines, and stale-data traps.

matchingRules.scope: user prompt text only (does not read file contents)
matchingRules.dedupe: if multiple entries match, emit at most 3 reminders per prompt, ordered by priority asc
matchingRules.cooldown: each entry fires at most once per 10 minutes per session to avoid nag loops

entries.hint: FileReadCache hook blocks duplicate Read (same session + path + mtime + offset + limit). If you genuinely need a fresh read, pass a different offset/limit or touch the file.
GrepResultCache hook blocks duplicate Grep within 5 min (same pattern+path+glob+type). Narrow the query or wait for TTL.
